findings.highlight: Things are getting serious
findings.evidenceJa: 事がここまで深刻になった以上
findings.governingReading: Matters have already become serious to this degree, which now justifies staying away from school.
findings.explanation: The English changes the reached threshold that motivates Shirou’s decision into an ongoing trend.

findings.highlight: My only reason to go to school was to meet Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 学校に行く目的の一つは遠坂との共闘だった
findings.governingReading: One purpose of attending school was Shirou’s combat alliance with Rin.
findings.explanation: The English falsely makes this his sole reason and reduces fighting together to meeting her.

findings.highlight: there’s no meaning in going outside
findings.evidenceJa: 昼間から外に出る意味はない
findings.governingReading: Shirou sees no point in going out during the daytime now that the alliance has ended.
findings.explanation: The English removes the time-of-day constraint and makes going outside categorically pointless.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s been looking healthy enough
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は元気に振舞っている
findings.governingReading: Sakura is deliberately behaving as though she is well.
findings.explanation: The English turns her performed facade into an external assessment of her health.

findings.highlight: it’ll all be over
findings.evidenceJa: こっちに打つ手はないんだ
findings.governingReading: If Zouken activates the crest worms, Shirou’s side will have no available move or countermeasure.
findings.explanation: The English overstates tactical helplessness as certain final defeat.

findings.highlight: activate just by looking at her
findings.evidenceJa: 虫どもを動かせる
findings.governingReading: Shirou supposes Zouken could set the multiple crest worms moving merely by seeing Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English suppresses both their plurality and the concrete motion Zouken may command.

findings.highlight: before Sakura finds out what I’m doing
findings.evidenceJa: 桜にその事実を知られないうちに
findings.governingReading: Shirou aims to end the war before Sakura learns the fact that she will not last long.
findings.explanation: The English changes the concealed content from Sakura’s prognosis to Shirou’s own activity.

findings.highlight: I’m taken aback
findings.evidenceJa: 少し意外だった
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s uneasy voice is slightly unexpected to Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English intensifies mild surprise into a strong emotional jolt.

findings.highlight: Sakura doesn’t want to fight
findings.evidenceJa: 自分から戦う気がない
findings.governingReading: Sakura has no intention of initiating or pursuing battle herself.
findings.explanation: The English erases the agency qualifier and turns this into a general absence of desire to fight.

findings.highlight: Hatred of battle
findings.evidenceJa: 戦いへの嫌悪
findings.governingReading: Shirou identifies Sakura’s aversion or revulsion toward battle.
findings.explanation: The English intensifies aversion into hatred.

findings.highlight: There are four more Masters
findings.evidenceJa: 残ったマスターは四人
findings.governingReading: Four Masters remain in the war.
findings.explanation: The English says four additional Masters, distorting the count’s relation to the current participants.

findings.highlight: she can manage it
findings.evidenceJa: キチンと鞘に収められる
findings.governingReading: Shirou trusts Rin to put the dangerous Grail properly back in its sheath—to contain and settle it.
findings.explanation: The English removes the concrete containment metaphor and reduces it to generic competence.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka is a magus
findings.evidenceJa: 一人前の魔術師だった
findings.governingReading: Rin is a fully fledged, competent magus despite also being a good person.
findings.explanation: The English drops the maturity and professional sufficiency that explain Shirou’s fear of her decision.

findings.highlight: she was willing to take it
findings.evidenceJa: 本気でそれを選択し、桜を手にかける覚悟を決めた
findings.governingReading: Rin seriously selected that course and resolved to kill Sakura with her own hand.
findings.explanation: The English compresses deliberate choice and personal killing resolve into vague willingness.

findings.highlight: a really happy one where nobody has to die
findings.evidenceJa: 誰も失わない、とんでもなくハッピーな世界
findings.governingReading: Shirou imagines Rin choosing an extraordinarily happy future in which nobody is lost.
findings.explanation: The English narrows every form of loss to death.

findings.highlight: it’d be a shame to put everything on her shoulders
findings.evidenceJa: あいつ任せってのは情けない
findings.governingReading: Shirou finds it pathetic or shameful in himself to leave everything to Rin.
findings.explanation: The English redirects the concern into the burden placed on Rin.

findings.highlight: I chose to lead Sakura’s way
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の手を引いて行くと決めた
findings.governingReading: Shirou decided to take Sakura by the hand and lead her onward.
findings.explanation: The English loses the physical and relational image and produces an unnatural abstract phrase.

findings.highlight: I appreciate your concern
findings.evidenceJa: 気持ちは嬉しいです
findings.governingReading: Sakura says Shirou’s feelings or intention make her happy.
findings.explanation: The English reduces her response to polite appreciation of concern.

findings.highlight: you’re enemies with Tohsaka-senpai now
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂先輩とも対立してしまった
findings.governingReading: Shirou has ended up in opposition to Rin.
findings.explanation: The English promotes present conflict into a categorical enemy relationship.

findings.highlight: Saber, who lost her life fighting for my selfish goals
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の我が侭につき合い、命を落としたセイバー
findings.governingReading: In Shirou’s current understanding, Saber went along with his selfish demand and lost her life.
findings.explanation: The English turns her relational decision to indulge or accompany him into service of his goals.

findings.highlight: it seems she understands
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は沈黙で肯定する
findings.governingReading: Sakura affirms the proposal through silence, and Shirou tentatively reads her as persuaded.
findings.explanation: The English replaces assent with comprehension.

findings.highlight: I’m getting used to her presence
findings.evidenceJa: 朝食からこっち、少しずつ居間にライダーが居る、という事に慣れつつある
findings.governingReading: Since breakfast, Shirou has gradually begun growing used to Rider specifically being in the living room.
findings.explanation: The English removes the elapsed process and household location.

findings.highlight: my beauty is being spoiled by its appearance
findings.evidenceJa: 私が美観を損ねる、と？
findings.governingReading: Rider pointedly asks whether Shirou means that she herself detracts from the view.
findings.explanation: The English reverses the relation, making the blindfold spoil Rider’s acknowledged beauty.

findings.highlight: that sultry thing
findings.evidenceJa: 暑苦しいの
findings.governingReading: Shirou calls the blindfold stifling or oppressively warm-looking.
findings.explanation: The English uses sultry, which suggests sexual attractiveness and contradicts the complaint.

findings.highlight: even if I saved my magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力をセーブしたところで
findings.governingReading: Even if Rider restrains or suppresses her magical energy, excluding Shirou from the eyes’ targets is difficult.
findings.explanation: The English makes her conserve a resource rather than hold its output down.

findings.highlight: Even if I’m captivated
findings.evidenceJa: 魔眼に囚われても
findings.governingReading: Even if Shirou is caught by the Mystic Eyes’ effect, he assumes Rider can undo it.
findings.explanation: The English suggests fascination or enchantment rather than magical capture.

findings.highlight: you can dispel me right away
findings.evidenceJa: すぐに解呪してくれる
findings.governingReading: Shirou expects Rider to remove or undo the curse immediately.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou himself the object to be dispelled, implying erasure rather than treatment.

findings.highlight: Rider is suddenly acting cold now
findings.evidenceJa: 冷たくライダーは言い放った
findings.governingReading: Rider delivers the prohibition coldly and decisively.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the manner and force of her speech with a general claim about how she is acting.
